style: Dark terminal HUD — near-black void, phosphor-green typed text, faint horizontal scanlines, blinking block cursor. CLI boot-up energy: lines appear as if typed into a root shell. Premium and legible, not chaotic. The cursor and green glow carry the hacker mood; the typography carries the brand.
hand_author: data-stream scene (progress bar wipe + red flash + micro-shake — no catalog block covers block-character progress bars with mid-bar colour flash)
HUD polish overlays (grain-overlay component, vignette component — add as composition layers; referenced from catalog but not assigned to a scene block)

scenes.motion: Token-streamed typing reveal via code-typing block: characters appear one-by-one at ~40ms intervals; green block caret tracks the frontier; faint green text-shadow glow on each char as it lands. Position: centered vertically, left-third horizontal. Scale: 48px, JetBrains Mono.

Typewriter continues via code-typing block; trailing ellipsis pulses (opacity 1 to 0.3 to 1, 0.4s cycle) suggesting active process. Text sits one line below boot-prompt, slightly smaller (40px) to read as sub-output. Ellipsis pulse: CSS opacity keyframes, not GSAP — seek-safe.

scenes.hand_author_reason: No catalog block covers a block-character progress bar with mid-bar colour flash and micro-shake. Build as a custom .clip scene: bar composed of span characters, GSAP clip-path or width tween left-to-right, red (#ff2244) flash on percentage at beat 42, micro-shake keyframes on 100% snap.
scenes.emotion: urgency, data rushing across the screen
scenes.motion: Rapid horizontal wipe left-to-right revealing a block-character progress bar (span-per-character, width tween or clip-path from 0 to 100%). Bar fills to 78% smoothly over 0.5s, then snaps to 100% with a micro-shake (GSAP keyframes: x: -9, 9, 0). Red (#ff2244) flash on the percentage number at beat frame 42. Characters: █ U+2588, ░ U+2591. Font: JetBrains Mono 42px.

RGB-split glitch-in via caption-glitch-rgb block: text flickers through offset red/green/blue channel layers with CRT scanline overlay, resolving into clean white-on-green after ~0.4s. The two words slam in from above (GSAP from y:-300, power4.out) with a subtle screen shake on land. Holds center-frame with a slow green glow pulse on text-shadow (GSAP to textShadow 0 0 46px #00ff88, yoyo, repeat 1, sine.inOut) for the remaining duration. Block cursor blinks steadily right of the lockup.
